notes: Manufacturer product page (denonpro.com) confirms: "The 300Z features both RCA audio outputs and balanced XLR outputs" with technical specs "Balanced XLR" Output Level +8 dBu and "Analog RCA terminals" 2 Vrms at 10kΩ. Cross-verified against the official Denon Professional DN-300Z User Guide (rear panel diagram, item-by-item connector list) mirrored by authorized UK distributor Valcom (valcom.co.uk), which explicitly labels the rear panel: Tuner Outputs (unbalanced RCA) - carries only the FM/AM tuner signal; CD/USB/SD/AUX/BT Outputs (unbalanced RCA); CD/USB/SD/AUX/BT Outputs (balanced XLR) - explicitly analog, described as sending "audio signals from a CD, USB device...SD card, device connected to the Aux In, and connected Bluetooth device" (i.e. NOT an AES/EBU digital output). The manufacturer's own official spec-sheet PDF (denonpro.com, mirrored at cdn-docs.av-iq.com) describes an OLDER/regional variant with RCA-only output ("Outputs consist of unbalanced RCA outputs") and no XLR - this appears to correspond to a discontinued "(Unbalanced)" US SKU also sold by B&H alongside a separate balanced "DN-300ZB" SKU. The current global denonpro.com product page and current user guide (used for this record) show combined RCA+XLR output, matching how the unit is currently listed by most retailers (e.g. Canford: "balanced XLR/unbal RCA out"). No coaxial/optical/AES digital output exists on this unit - some third-party summaries incorrectly mention "SPDIF," but this is not present on the manufacturer's actual page or user guide and could not be confirmed anywhere authoritative; treat as unconfirmed/likely erroneous. Omitted from port list: SD/SDHC card slot (front panel) - no connector ID in the allowed list fits a card-slot; FM antenna terminal, AM loop antenna terminals, and Bluetooth antenna terminal (rear panel) - these are simple screw/spring wire terminals for included antennas, not standard connectors in the provided list (closest analogues like bnc/f-type did not match the actual terminal style shown in the rear-panel diagram, so they were omitted rather than mis-mapped). No connector on this device carries a bandwidth grade (all audio connectors: RCA, XLR analog, TRS, USB-A for mass storage only) so no grade fields were set. Category/type set to "source"/"Media player" (closest fit to "Media source"/"Media player" naming); rackUnits=1 (1RU chassis, though it also ships with removable rack ears for tabletop use).

ports.note: Stereo RCA output carrying CD, USB, SD, Aux-In, and Bluetooth program material; 2 Vrms at 10kΩ load
